description: Validate Playwright tests against the anti-flakiness best-practice rubric — score a single *.spec.ts or a whole folder/glob, report per-test findings with severity and line refs, then offer to auto-fix the mechanically-fixable ones under confirmation. Generates no test. Shared as the post-fidelity gate inside [ET].
output-location: stdout (read, score and report; auto-fix rewrites existing specs only under confirmation; no durable artifact)
